comment: AGI-OS control plane. Four separated planes, two routers.
agents[]      whole-mission adapters (Agent Router) — optional, gated on account validity
models[]      free-first prompt APIs (Model Router) — the default operating layer
deployments[] who publishes the artefact (observe = the platform deploys itself)
verifications[] what proves the published artefact works
Policy: FREE_ONLY. No provider may be auto-upgraded to metered billing; a manifest that
declares a paid free-tier without a hard stop is rejected at parse time, not at bill time.
Secrets are never written here: reference an env var name in accountNotes instead. Values in
dollar-brace form are expanded at load time and MUST carry a fallback, since a silently
empty base URL turns into a mysterious connection failure.
Facts recorded 2026-09-14 from the operator's notes: OpenRouter lists openrouter/free over ~25 free
models; Gemini free tier exists with per-model/per-account limits; Cerebras grants ~5 USD trial
credit; Hugging Face grants ~0.10 USD per month then converts to pay-as-you-go; Cloudflare Workers AI
grants 10000 neurons per day with some models paid-plan only. Limits below are OUR enforced ceilings
(deliberately at or under the published value) — re-check them before trusting a rung.

models.label: OpenRouter Free
models.accountNotes: auth via env OPENROUTER_API_KEY. The :free suffix is what keeps this free; a model id without it is metered and must not be requested. freeTier.freeModels is our allowlist — add to it only after checking the model page.

models.label: Gemini API Free Tier

freeTier.source: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing — free tier is per model and per account (2026-09-14)

models.accountNotes: auth via env GEMINI_API_KEY. Treated as quota-aware, never as unlimited: rate limits and model eligibility move with the account, so a 429 here is expected and must cool down rather than fail the mission.

models.label: Cerebras Inference (trial credit)

freeTier.source: cerebras.ai/pricing — ~5 USD introductory credit, then metered (2026-09-14)

models.accountNotes: auth via env CEREBRAS_API_KEY. This is a finite grant, not a free tier: when remaining hits 0 the router must move on instead of starting a bill. Good for quick loops, not for a long mission.

models.label: Hugging Face Inference Providers

freeTier.source: huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/pricing — ~0.10 USD/month on the free account, pay-as-you-go after (2026-09-14)

models.accountNotes: auth via env HF_TOKEN. hardStop is the entire point of this entry: past the monthly credit HF bills the account, so at remaining=0 the provider is refused, not retried.

models.label: Cloudflare Workers AI

freeTier.source: developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing — 10000 neurons/day on the free plan; some models are paid-plan only (2026-09-14)

models.accountNotes: Not bound in this repository (no CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/HF-style token in repo secrets), so it is declared disabled rather than quietly missing: the router reports 'disabled in the manifest'. Free allowance is per MODEL as well as per day — freeTier.freeModels is checked before selection, which is what stops a paid-plan model id from silently costing neurons.

models.label: Local llama.cpp / Ollama / Jan
models.accountNotes: No API key, no egress, no per-call cost. Ollama speaks OpenAI-compatible on :11434/v1, llama.cpp server on :8080/v1, Jan on :13373/v1 — point LOCAL_INFERENCE_URL at whichever is up. This is the last rung before BLOCKED: it keeps a mission alive when every cloud allowance is spent, at the price of whatever the local model cannot do (no network tools, smaller context).

agents.label: Arena Agent Mode
agents.accountNotes: Interactive plane. Its tool budget running out is expected and is a routing input (cooldown), not an error: the ladder continues on the free model plane without a human. Account validity is expressed as health — probe before use.

agents.label: Codex (subscription plan)
agents.accountNotes: Optional adapter. Allowed for coding work only when the plan is valid; never the free path, and never allowed to deploy by itself.

agents.label: Claude API
agents.accountNotes: Metered per call, therefore unreachable by automation. It stays in the manifest on purpose: FREE_ONLY should be provable against a real paid entry, not against an imaginary one. Using it requires a manifest edit AND an explicit paid:override approval.

agents.label: Manus
agents.accountNotes: Credit-metered adapter: chosen for a big mission only when the account is available and valid; it is an optional adapter, not part of the free operating layer.

deployments.notes: Production branch = main; the Vercel Git integration owns the build. We never trigger Vercel from CI: we read x-vercel-id at verify time so the verdict names the exact build it tested. Serving 200 is NOT proof the backend works — see verifications[0].

We own this publish step (git push of apps/hf-backend), so it is a publish-mode target and requires HF_TOKEN. Space must be sdk=docker with APP_FILE=app.py. Status as of 2026-09-14: this host answers 404 and sayed101-agi-system reports 'Your space is in error' — verification is expected to FAIL until the Space is repointed. That failure is the gate working.
No account bound in this repository's secrets, so it reports BLOCKED from the deployment plane instead of being silently absent.

verifications.label: Post-deploy functional verification
verifications.notes: verification.ts. GET / → 200 → valid HTML → expected marker → backend /health → /ready → /v1/models → chat contract. Produces {frontend, frontend_http, backend, backend_health, api_contract, deployment}.

verifications.label: Production certification suite
verifications.notes: tests/production (66 specs, 287 assertions). Its summary is the Deployment Gate's third input: Deploy=Ready plus Certification=BLOCKED means DEPLOYED ≠ VERIFIED → FINAL GATE = BLOCKED.
